Elliptic: Binance Hacker Uses CoinJoin for First Time as 44% of Stolen Funds Are Frozen Elliptic said laundering of the roughly $6.43 billion stolen from Binance has involved 11 blockchains, around 12,000 wallets and more than 40,000 transactions. About $2.85 billion, or 44%, has been frozen or seized, while roughly $3.24 billion remains in linked addresses. Tron was a major route, with funds spread across about 7,700 addresses; the attacker has also begun using CoinJoin, while about $16 million was sent to addresses linked to the earlier Bitget hack. — link

ZachXBT: EU entity suspected of losing over $106M in crypto theft On-chain investigator ZachXBT reported on November 2 that an EU-based entity is suspected of losing more than $106 million from multiple centralized exchange accounts on November 1. The suspected attacker withdrew the funds in USDC and USDT and has since been actively swapping USDC for ETH, transferring assets through instant exchange services including WellWallet and Kyrrex, converting funds into privacy coin XMR via Wagyu, and bridging assets across multiple blockchains. The identity of the affected entity and the method of the suspected theft remain undisclosed. The reported losses have not yet been independently confirmed. — link

Strategy buys 811 BTC for $65.5M, holds 849,327 BTC total According to an SEC Form 8-K filed on November 2, Strategy purchased 811 BTC for approximately $65.5 million between October 26 and November 1, at an average price of $80,846 per BTC. As of November 1, the company held 849,327 BTC, acquired for a total of approximately $64.08 billion at an average cost of $75,451 per BTC. During the same period, Strategy sold approximately 1.18 million shares of MSTR common stock, generating $164 million in net proceeds, of which $65.5 million was used to purchase Bitcoin and $98.5 million was allocated to USD Cash. The company also repurchased approximately 2.09 million shares of its STRC preferred stock for $208.2 million. — link

BitMine adds 8,573 ETH, holdings reach 6.06M ETH BitMine said it acquired 8,573 ETH over the past week, bringing total holdings to 6,060,506 ETH, or about 4.9% of Ethereum’s supply. The company has 5,227,037 ETH staked, while total crypto, cash, marketable securities and other investments stand at about $14.5 billion, including $498 million in cash and marketable securities. — link
